03 / The artist

About the Artist

Angelina

Artist & Writer

Angelina brings imaginative characters, everyday details, and personal stories to life through drawing and writing. Her nonfiction article ‘Iron Sharpens Iron’ appeared in the Spring 2023 issue of Charleston Women, and she received a Silver Key in writing through the Scholastic Art & Writing Awards in 2023.
